audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Joseph's self-revelation, divine sending/providence, brotherly reconciliation, Pharaoh's welcome, wagons, and Jacob revived.

verses.restored: Joseph could not restrain himself before all who stood by him, and he cried, Make everyone go out from me. No one stood with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

familiar.text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

verses.restored: He gave his voice in weeping, and the Egyptians heard, and Pharaoh’s house heard.

familiar.text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

verses.restored: Joseph said to his brothers, I am Joseph. Is my father still alive? But his brothers could not answer him, for they were terrified before his face.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

verses.restored: Joseph said to his brothers, Please come near to me. They came near, and he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

familiar.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

verses.restored: Now do not be grieved or angry in your eyes because you sold me here, for the Divine sent me before you to preserve life.

familiar.text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

verses.restored: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are still five years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.

familiar.text: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

verses.restored: The Divine sent me before you to set for you a remnant in the earth and to keep you alive by a great escape.

familiar.text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.restored: So now, it was not you who sent me here, but the Divine. He has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

familiar.text: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.restored: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, Thus says your son Joseph: The Divine has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; do not stand still.

familiar.text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

verses.restored: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near me, you and your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that is yours.

familiar.text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

verses.restored: There I will sustain you, for there are still five years of famine, lest you and your house and all that is yours become impoverished.

familiar.text: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

verses.restored: Look, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth speaking to you.

familiar.text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

verses.restored: Tell my father of all my weight/glory in Egypt and all that you have seen. Hurry and bring my father down here.

familiar.text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

verses.restored: He fell on Benjamin his brother’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

familiar.text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.restored: He kissed all his brothers and wept upon them; afterward his brothers spoke with him.

familiar.text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

verses.restored: The sound was heard in Pharaoh’s house: Joseph’s brothers have come. It was good in the eyes of Pharaoh and in the eyes of his servants.

familiar.text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

verses.restored: Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Do this: load your animals and go, enter the land of Canaan.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

verses.restored: Take your father and your households and come to me. I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.

familiar.text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.restored: You are commanded: do this. Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and your women, lift up your father, and come.

familiar.text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.restored: Let your eye not pity your goods, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

familiar.text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

verses.restored: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons according to Pharaoh’s command and gave them provisions for the way.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

verses.restored: To each of them he gave changes of garments, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred silver pieces and five changes of garments.

familiar.text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

verses.restored: To his father he sent ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and food for his father on the way.

familiar.text: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

verses.restored: He sent his brothers away, and they went. He said to them, Do not be agitated on the way.

familiar.text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

verses.restored: They went up from Egypt and came to the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

familiar.text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

verses.restored: They told him, Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt. His heart went numb, for he did not believe them.

familiar.text: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

verses.restored: They spoke to him all Joseph’s words that he had spoken to them, and he saw the wagons Joseph had sent to carry him; then the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

familiar.text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

verses.restored: Israel said, Enough! Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.

familiar.text: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
